info.name: Sakan Server API
info.description:
Sakan Server REST API collection ({{baseUrl}}). Includes saved example responses so frontend can see response shapes.

Auth: Most endpoints require Bearer token. After running Register, Verify OTP (legacy accounts only) or Login, the collection will store the token into the collection variable {{token}}.

item.description:
**Purpose**: Creates a new student/landlord account. OTP verification is disabled: the account is created already verified and the response returns the user plus a Bearer token (stored into `{{token}}`), ready for authenticated calls.

**Auth**: No authentication required.

**Roles**: Public - anyone may call this endpoint.

**Body**: Each field is documented inline as a JSON comment (comments are stripped by the pre-request script before sending).

**Note**: `Send OTP` / `Verify OTP` remain only for legacy accounts that were never verified.

item.description:
**Purpose**: Performs a structured search over properties with type, city, price, room, state, and radius filters.

**Auth**: Bearer token required (collection-level, uses `{{token}}`).

**Roles**: admin, landlord, student

**Query parameters**:
- `q` (OPTIONAL) - Free-text keyword.
- `type` (OPTIONAL) - Filter by property type.. Options: `flat`, `room`.
- `city` (OPTIONAL) - Case-insensitive partial match on the property city.
- `minPrice` (OPTIONAL) - Minimum price per month.
- `maxPrice` (OPTIONAL) - Maximum price per month.
- `minRooms` (OPTIONAL) - Minimum total rooms.
- `maxRooms` (OPTIONAL) - Maximum total rooms.
- `state` (OPTIONAL) - Filter by workflow state.. Options: `drafted`, `sent`, `approved`, `declined`.
- `isActive` (OPTIONAL) - Filter by active status.. Options: `true`, `false`.
- `latitude` (OPTIONAL) - Center latitude (with longitude + radiusKm).
- `longitude` (OPTIONAL) - Center longitude (with latitude + radiusKm).
- `radiusKm` (OPTIONAL) - Search radius in km (0-100).
- `page` (OPTIONAL) - Page number for pagination.
- `limit` (OPTIONAL) - Number of results per page (1-100).

**Purpose**: Returns properties near a given latitude/longitude within a radius. Uses the `long` query name (server spelling) and `radiusKm`.

**Auth**: Bearer token required (collection-level, uses `{{token}}`).

**Roles**: any authenticated user

**Query parameters**:
- `lat` (REQUIRED) - Latitude of the center point.
- `long` (REQUIRED) - Longitude of the center point (server spelling).
- `radiusKm` (OPTIONAL) - Search radius in km (0-100, default 5).
- `page` (OPTIONAL) - Page number for pagination.
- `limit` (OPTIONAL) - Number of results per page.

item.description:
**Purpose**: Creates a new property with images sent as multipart/form-data. The file field is named `images` (repeat it for multiple files, max 10; the first image becomes the cover). Same text fields as the JSON variant. The test script captures the new id into `{{propertyId}}` and `{{draftedPropertyId}}`.

**Auth**: Bearer token required (collection-level, uses `{{token}}`).

**Roles**: student, landlord

**Body (multipart/form-data)**:
- `images` (REQUIRED) - Image file(s). Repeat for multiple files (max 10). Uses `{{imagePath1}}` / `{{imagePath2}}` env vars.
- `title` (REQUIRED) - Display title.
- `description` (REQUIRED) - Description.
- `pricePerMonth` (REQUIRED) - Price per month.
- `totalRooms` (REQUIRED) - Total rooms.
- `availableRooms` (REQUIRED) - Available rooms.
- `type` (REQUIRED) - Property type.. Options: `flat`, `room`.
- `locationLat` (OPTIONAL) - Latitude.
- `locationLong` (OPTIONAL) - Longitude.
- `address` (OPTIONAL) - Street address.
- `amenities` (OPTIONAL) - JSON object string of boolean flags.
